summary:
SUMMARY

Space Quiz is an educational game that takes players on an exciting journey through the universe. In the game, the player becomes an astronaut whose mission is to explore different planets and learn interesting facts about space. Throughout the adventure, players answer multiple-choice questions, complete challenges, and earn points for correct answers. The game features five stages, including Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, and the Solar System. With colorful graphics, simple controls, and an easy-to-understand interface, Space Quiz combines entertainment and education, encouraging curiosity and helping players learn more about astronomy in a fun and interactive way.
details: PROJECT DETAILS Space Quiz is an educational 2D game designed to teach players about space, planets, and the Solar System in a fun and interactive way. The player takes the role of an astronaut who travels through space, visits different planets, and answers educational questions to complete each stage. For every correct answer, the player earns 10 points and learns interesting facts about the universe. The main benefit of the project is making education more entertaining and accessible. It encourages students to develop curiosity, improve their knowledge of astronomy, and learn through interactive activities instead of only reading information. The intended impact is to make learning about space more interesting, especially for young students. The game aims to combine entertainment and education, showing that technology and games can be useful tools in the learning process. The project was designed as a simple game prototype using digital illustrations and visual interface concepts. No physical hardware is required. For future development, tools such as Unity or Godot could be used, together with programming languages such as C# or GDScript. Another possibility would be developing the game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The creative aspect of Space Quiz is its combination of space exploration, an astronaut character, colorful environments, and educational challenges. Players learn while progressing through different planets, making the experience more engaging. During the project development, the team considered factors such as simplicity, accessibility, visual design, educational value, and ease of use. The objective was to create a game that is easy to understand, enjoyable to play, and capable of teaching basic astronomy.
